name: date-input
title: Date Input
description: A segmented date input with keyboard editing and locale-aware formatting.

props.name: allSegments
props.description: The computed segments map for the formatter.

props.name: createCalendar
props.description:
A function that creates a calendar object for a given calendar identifier.
Use this to support non-Gregorian calendars (e.g., Persian, Islamic, Buddhist).

props.name: dir
props.description: The document's text/writing direction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the date input is disabled.

props.name: form
props.description: The `form` attribute of the hidden input element.

props.name: format
props.description: The format function for converting a DateValue to a string.

props.name: formatter
props.description: The date formatter to use.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Determines the smallest unit that is displayed in the date input.

props.name: hideTimeZone
props.description:
Whether to hide the time zone segment when the value is a `ZonedDateTime`.
Has no effect for values without a time zone.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description:
Whether to use 12-hour or 24-hour time format.
By default, this is determined by the locale.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the date input. Useful for composition.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Whether the date input is invalid

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description:
Returns whether a date is unavailable.
When a committed date matches, the input is marked as invalid.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale (BCP 47 language tag) to use when formatting the date.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum date that can be selected.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum date that can be selected.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` attribute of the input element.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the date input is read-only.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether the date input is required

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
The selection mode of the date input.
- `single` - only one date can be entered
- `range` - a range of dates can be entered (start and end)

props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros
props.description:
Whether to always show leading zeros in month, day, and hour fields.
When false, formatting follows the locale default (e.g. "1" instead of "01").

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The time zone to use

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

events.name: onFocusChange
events.description: A function called when the date input gains or loses focus.

events.name: onPlaceholderChange
events.description: A function called when the placeholder value changes.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Function called when the value changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A date input with empty segments, ready for keyboard entry.

examples.title: With value
examples.description: Pass `value` as an array of ISO date strings to pre-fill the segments.

examples.title: Custom locale
examples.description: Pass `locale` to change segment order and formatting, e.g. `fr-FR`.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled date input is skipped by the tab order and ignores input.

examples.title: Date range
examples.description: Set `selectionMode="range"` to render two segment groups for a start and end date.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import DateInput from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/date-input/date-input.marko";
value: ${value.join(", ") || "(empty)"}
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.
